paraphrase: Definitions: bondage is identifying self with non-self; liberation is its cessation; ignorance is that through which this happens; knowledge that which removes it; the states, sheaths, jīva, witness, kūṭastha, inner controller, pratyagātman, paramātman and māyā are each defined.

checks.note: The e-text numbers the Sarvasāra in only 4 prose sections. The questions and definitions (bondage, liberation, avidyā, vidyā, the states, sheaths, jīva, sākṣin, kūṭastha, antaryāmin, pratyagātman, paramātman, māyā) take up the whole text. There is no section 20 in this recension.
